# test/fixtures/templates — The 11 real template rows (10 distinct; `oiaISYb2` 単語 is defined in both 日本語 and 基本情報). `manifest.json` is generated from `exports/` by `npx vite-node test/fixtures/templates/extract.ts` and is never hand-edited — `test/template.test.ts` re-reads the exports and fails if the two have drifted. `parsed.golden.json` is the pinned AST of all ten, written by vitest's file snapshot; regenerate with `npx vitest run test/template.test.ts -u`. Committed so the surface-2 half of stage 3 is testable without the 657 MB of gitignored exports.
